features.requiredBehavior: Company-scoped employee DM from directory, profile, search and work context; active HRIS identity and admission.
Groups: name, avatar, description, members, admins, invitations, leave, invitation policy and membership history.
Multiline text, basic formatting, emoji, mentions, links, quoted replies and reactions; safe data rendering.
Owned offline history, drafts, durable message/attachment queue, cancel pending, bounded retry and recovery after process/device restart.
Pending, sending, server-accepted, device-delivered, read and failed; delivery acknowledgement follows recipient durable storage.
Edit with indicator, forward one/multiple messages, attachment captions and forwarded indicator; retry deduplication.
Delete for me across owned devices; delete for everyone through redaction, sync and restore reconciliation.
Multiple photos, videos and documents, quality selection, preview, captions, per-file progress/cancel/retry and network-specific downloads.
Voice-note record/lock/pause/resume/discard/preview, waveform, seek, 1/1.5/2x playback and audio focus.
Static/animated stickers, licensed bundled packs, import, favorites, recents and bounded decoding.
Local message/media search, unread filter, pin/archive/mute, draft indicators, jump to message, read-receipt/presence preferences.
Verified device list, QR/security-code verification, new-device notice, revoke, history/read-state sync and key recovery.
Per-conversation notifications, native inline reply, mark read/mute, locked-screen privacy and precise deep links.
Manual/scheduled encrypted backups, optional videos, progress/size, cloud account choice, recovery key, restore and device transfer.
DM claim card and dedicated claim room, live resource authorization, approver replacement, selected E2EE history handover and extensible context types.
Start one-to-one calls from chat, profile, call history or callback notification.
Group calls, selected invitees, additional invites, join ongoing and rejoin after interruption.
Incoming calls in foreground/background/locked/system-terminated states, subject to OS admission.
Answer, decline, cancel, hang up, callback; distinct missed/busy/declined/unavailable/failed outcomes.
Ring admitted devices; exactly one winning acceptance for a recipient; stop other devices.
Mute, speaker/earpiece, wired/Bluetooth routing, route changes, proximity and system audio focus.
Waiting-call reject or end-and-answer, with Telecom/CallKit cellular interruption integration.
Cross-device history: direction, participants, times, connected duration and termination reason.
Wi-Fi/mobile handover, reconnect, network quality, adaptive bitrate and data-saving mode.
Persistent in-app call controls across HRIS navigation plus system mute/hang-up controls.
E2EE, participant identity/change visibility, key rotation, block/report and DND/Focus respect.
Start video or request upgrade from voice; recipient consent and camera permission.
Front/back and web camera selection, on/off, self preview/mirroring and orientation.
One-to-one/group grid, active speaker, pinning, movable self preview and camera-off states.
Native PiP and in-app minimized call without creating another media connection.
Screen capture and supported system audio; web screen/window/tab and native capture permission.
Adaptive resolution, simulcast, bandwidth degradation and retained audio when video stops.
Device-processed background/blur, framing and lightweight effects with capability limits.
E2EE, consistent media/capture indicators and OS-compliant background capture.
Instant/scheduled/recurring meetings, title/description/host, timezone, join code/link, reschedule/cancel/remind.
HRIS meeting calendar, ICS, opt-in Google/Outlook integration for app-created/linked events.
Pre-join camera/microphone/speaker selection/test, guest name, connectivity check and initial media selection.
Knock/waiting room, admit/reject, lock, invitation limits and removed-guest handling.
Host/co-host/presenter/participant/viewer, 500 interactive plus 500 viewer capacity, atomic seat/role admission.
Host mute, restrictions on unmute/camera/share/chat, removal, co-host/host transfer, leave/end for all; no forced microphone activation.
Grid, spotlight, active speaker, pin, fullscreen, speaker plus presentation, participant/chat sidebars and adaptive mobile layout.
Raised-hand queue, reactions, speaking indicators and speaking-while-muted notice.
Screen/window/tab and supported audio sharing, presenter changes, pointer, annotation and presentation permissions.
E2EE meeting chat/replies/mentions/files, moderation, post-meeting access; guests have no employee directory/company chat access.
Manual/automatic breakout assignment, transfers, timer, host broadcast/help request and return to main room.
Scheduled/live polls, anonymous option, votes, moderated Q&A, answered marker and results export.
Collaborative whiteboard shapes/text/sticky notes/pointer, undo/redo, snapshots and exports.
Authorized recording start/stop, visible consent/indicator, async processing/playback/download and partial/failed outcomes.
Indonesian/English captions/transcripts, speaker identity, timestamps, corrections, search and export.
ID/EN caption translation, grounded summaries/decisions/action items/catch-up/Q&A; timestamp sources and draft publishing.
Attendance join/leave/rejoin/duration/roles and authorized meeting artifacts/results page.
Companion device for chat/polls/presentation with audio disabled to prevent echo and capacity accounting.
Keyboard, screen readers, captions, labels/touch targets, themes, reduced motion and text scaling.
Reconnect/network change/host recovery, recorder/AI failures and full rooms without displacing existing attendees.
